reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request updates `VerilogWriter::writeAssigns` to handle input ports with names differing from their connected nets, reversing the assignment direction (`assign net = port;`) for input ports. The feedback suggests refactoring the logic to determine the left-hand side and right-hand side variables beforehand, which avoids duplicating the `sta::print` call and improves maintainability.
